name: v1.40.7 - Reindexing and replica recovery fixes
body:
## Breaking Changes 
*none*

## New Features
*none*

## Fixes
* Fix sort and aggregate results while a reindex enables a filter index by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13921
* Let a replica movement replay writes stored without a class name by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13961
* Fail over off a recovering replica on replicated reads and vector search by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13938
* reindex: fix tenant and schema changes stalling during a large reindex (8.7 s to 58 µs at 1M tenants) by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13872
* Backport: fix(lsmkv): return an error for damaged RoaringSet WAL record lengths by @jfrancoa in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13945

## Deprecations
* Deprecate remaining classless endpoints by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13967

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/compare/v1.40.6...v1.40.7
